channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: TCS urges employees to use AI even if it cuts revenue: CEO Krithivasan
item.description: Tata Consultancy Services CEO K Krithivasan has urged employees to actively use AI tools to deliver work faster and at lower cost, even if it affects short-term revenue. Speaking at the Nasscom Technology and Leadership Forum in Mumbai, he said embracing AI-driven efficiencies is crucial

item.title: NSE IX to open 30 overseas markets for Indian investors: Report
item.description: NSE International Exchange (NSE IX) plans to allow Indian investors to access 30 overseas markets over the next three to six months through its Global Access platform. Currently offering US stocks, the exchange aims to expand to G7 nations, including countries in Europe, Japan, and the UK.

item.title: Social media drives 77 pc of retail discovery led by Meta platforms: Report
item.description: Social media now influences 77% of retail purchase decisions in India, with Meta platforms driving the majority of product discovery, according to a report by Meta and the Retailers Association of India. Short-form videos, creators, and WhatsApp messaging are playing a key role in shaping consumer journeys.

item.title: ED attaches Anil Ambani's Rs 3,716 crore house in Mumbai
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate has provisionally attached Anil Ambani's Pali Hill residence 'Abode', valued at Rs 3,716.83 crore, under the PMLA. Earlier, properties worth Rs 473.17 crore were also attached.

item.title: Vande Bharat Jammu extension deferred; security concerns behind Railway board decision
item.description: The Railway Board has put on hold the extension of the Vande Bharat Express from Srinagar to Jammu, just hours after Northern Railways announced its launch from March 1. Sources attribute the decision to security inputs warning of possible sabotage attempts. The deferment has left passengers and stakeholders awaiting clarity on a revised launch date.

item.title: India aims to build stable, trustworthy capital markets for long-term global investors: SEBI Chairman
item.description: The platform allows fully digital onboarding without a demat account and follows a T+1 settlement cycle. It offers zero stamp duty, zero STT, and zero capital gains tax for non-residents, with trading in US dollars. Regulated by the International Financial Services Centres Authority.

item.title: 'Not real tattoo': Karan Kundrra clarifies tattoo of Tejasswi Prakash's face on his chest is temporary
item.description: Karan Kundrra took the internet by storm when he flaunted his girlfriend Tejasswi's tattooed face on his right chest. As the videos went viral, fans debated that it doesn't look real. However, Karan confirmed that the tattoo is temporary and it's for Teju's upcoming show Psycho Saiyaan.

item.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, S26+, S26 go official: First impressions reveal "magical" treat [Watch]
item.description: Samsung has gone official with its latest flagships, Galaxy S26 Ultra, S26+ and S26. Here's our first look at the phones and some initial thoughts.

item.title: Two Maoists killed in encounter with security forces in Chhattisgarh's Bijapur
item.description: Two Maoists were killed in an encounter with security forces in the Indravati river area of Bijapur, Chhattisgarh, after specific intelligence inputs. Arms and explosives, including SLR and INSAS rifles, were recovered from the site.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty trade flat with positive bias; IT index gains 1 pc
item.description: As of 9.25 am, Sensex added 58 points, or 0.07 per cent, to reach 82,334, and Nifty gained 15 points, or 0.06 per cent, at 25,498.
